## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-6006 by diagnosing why the orders-api 3.9.0 pods are stuck at Init:0/1 status. The investigation revealed that the vault-agent-init container cannot complete initialization for the new 3.9.0 image, while the 3.8.0 pods successfully complete the same initialization with identical Vault configuration. This indicates a change in the 3.9.0 application image that affects how it interacts with Vault secret injection. I provided the ticket owner with actionable steps including reviewing the release changes, comparing startup sequences, verifying Vault permissions with the security team, and rolling back to 3.8.0 while investigating the root cause.
